title: Signed erased-index boundary of the canonical negative Koszul basis
statement: Let O be a commutative ring sheaf on a small site, A a commutative ring in the same universe, rho:A→End(O) a ring homomorphism, a:Fin r→A, and s_i global sections with rho(a_i)=ringedKoszulScalar O s_i. For fixed n, integer q, and I with q=-card I, the canonical negative basis map on I followed by its actual differential equals the sum over i in I of rho((-1)^(card of the selected indices earlier than i) times a_i^(n+1)), followed by the canonical negative basis map on I.erase i in degree q+1. No coproduct, duality, transition, exterior coefficient, or coordinate choice is asserted.

source.place: Tags 0622 and 0664, ordered Koszul generators and the graded Leibniz rule; algebraization.tex, Tag 0A0E, lemma-derived-completion-koszul, finite free duality.

proof.text: Evaluate endomorphisms of the regular sheaf at one, giving a ring homomorphism to global sections and identifying each supplied generator with s_i. Apply ringedNegativeKoszulSummand_D₂_succ to the coefficient complex O[0]. Its first tensor differential is zero. On a supported subset the coefficient degree q+card I is zero, so the additional coefficient-complex sign is positive. The left unitor identifies the specified summand inclusion, preceded by the inverse single-complex isomorphism, with ringedNegativeKoszulBasis. Naturality of scalar action and the equality transports then give the signed sum over i in I erasing i, with coefficient (-1)^(number of earlier selected indices) times a_i^(n+1). For no factors the complex is O[0] and its boundary is zero.

lean.statement:
theorem ringedNegativeKoszulBasis_signed_d
    {C : Type w} [SmallCategory C] {T : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (O : Sheaf T CommRingCat.{w}) {A : Type w} [CommRing A]
    (ρ : A →+* End (SheafOfModules.unit
      ((sheafCompose T (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O)))
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (s : Fin r → (O.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections)
    (hρ : ∀ i, ρ (a i) = ringedKoszulScalar O (s i))
    (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ) (I : exteriorKoszulIndex r q) :
    ringedNegativeKoszulBasis O r s n I.1 q ≫
        (ringedNegativeKoszul O r s n).d q (q + 1) =
      ∑ i ∈ I.1, ρ ((-1 : A) ^ (I.1.filter (fun j ↦ j < i)).card * a i ^ (n + 1)) ≫
        ringedNegativeKoszulBasis O r s n (I.1.erase i) (q + 1)
